text:
Type: large round low coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor in front of a sofa; living room, lounge
Style: mid-century modern, Scandinavian, contemporary
Materials: walnut veneer top, solid wood legs in a matching walnut tone
Colors: warm medium brown walnut
Shape: wide round top with a thin edge, four angled tapered legs set inward, low and broad, medium visual weight
Feel: warm, refined, relaxed, timeless
Goes with: leather or wool sofas, cream or green walls, brass accents; mid-century, Scandinavian or modern living rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: The table surface in walnut veneer and legs in solid walnut give a warm, natural feeling to your room.
